title: 4.0: Add error handling to `x509_v3_set_ctx` and `x509_v3_set_nconf`
body:
These two commits:

* `X509V3_set_nconf()`: Improve error handling using this function, mostly in `apps/`
* `X509V3_set_ctx()`: Improve error handling mostly in `apps/` ~and documentation~

have been carved out from #16342 to simplify the latter. 
They bring minor improvements to the mentioned lib functions and their use in `apps/`, 
where two further auxiliary functions are added to `apps.c` in order to reduce redundancy.

##### Checklist
<!-- Remove items that do not apply. For completed items, change [ ] to [x]. -->
- [x] documentation is added or updated
- [ ] tests are added or updated
